New visits are created once per day by the system when a slot is due. Clients are not charged automatically for those visits—payment works like your other bookings (pay in app, at the venue, etc.).

When a date is due, we try to book the same staff and time. If that slot is taken, the run may skip that day—check Bookings or contact the salon. Pausing stops new visits; cancel ends the whole series.

Automated ID checks are not available on this build yet. Use manual upload below — photos should be clear and uncropped. We usually review within 1–2 business days and you will see status updates here.

The card machine took a different amount than the balance due, so it was not applied to this charge automatically. It has been flagged for review — the balance still shows as owing until it is resolved.

Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform-settled payments). Cash and Yoco service payments you collected are not included. Earnings use the day you were paid. Appointments use the day they are scheduled.

Ledger line uses finance_transactions (earnings, travel, tips) by recognition date. Visit counts use appointment dates (excl. cancelled & no-show). They are different bases — spread does not imply causation.

Business-wide balance (not filtered by branch). Platform-held payoutable money after completed payouts and pending requests. Cash, EFT, manual card, and card machines (Yoco/PayCloud) you collected directly are excluded.
